question:
The following chart shows the distribution (percentage-wise) of the total number of computers sold by dealers A and B together during 5 months. Study the chart and answer the given question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42873d3682fb13a5a4d3b8a30f600995150fb0831a873184af95e82f9d6d7ef6.png] 

Total number of computers sold by dealers A and B in March = 576

The ratio of computers sold by dealers A and B in February is 6 : 5. The difference between the number of computers sold by A and B is x. The value of x will be between _______.
solution:
Calculation:

From the pie chart, 24% or 576 computers were sold by dealers A and B in March.

Total computers sold = 576over24 × 100 = 2400

Computers sold during February = 18over100 × 2400 = 432

Difference of the ratio of the computers sold by A and B = 1over11 × 432 = 39.27

∴ The difference in the computers sold by A and B is around 39.

And 39 is between 35 and 40.
